title: Compute MSCB quantities and write results CSV
action: Implement the analytical model for a three-point bending multilayer structure curved beam (MSCB). Compute the effective modulus ratio E/E1, the moment of inertia Iz and maximum static moment Sz_max of the layered cross-section, the bending stiffness ratio κ, the maximum normal stress σ_max and maximum shear stress τ_max at beam center, the critical loads P1 (brittle fracture) and P2 (interfacial shear), the bending strength ratio χ = min(P1,P2)/P0, the plastic region length L_c, and the fracture energy W_MSCB. Evaluate all formulas for the prescribed parameter grid (arch height δ, span L, beam width B, beam height H, volume fraction V_f, aspect ratio ρ, overlap ratio Φ, modulus ratio λ, hard layer strength σ_b, interfacial shear strength τ_s, surface energy γ) defined in the task instructions. Write the results to the output CSV file with one row per parameter combination, listing all input parameter values and every computed quantity. Use SI units for all dimensional quantities.
description: The main reproduction artifact containing all computed mechanical quantities for the MSCB model, evaluated over the requested parameter grid.
output_schema: CSV with columns: V_f (volume fraction), rho (aspect ratio), Phi (overlap ratio), lambda (modulus ratio E1/G2), h2_over_H (soft layer thickness fraction), delta (arch height), L (span), B (width), H (height), sigma_b (hard layer strength), tau_s (interfacial shear strength), gamma (surface energy), E_ratio, I_z, S_zmax, kappa, sigma_max, tau_max, P1, P2, chi, L_c, W_PASB, W_MSCB. All length-related quantities in m, forces in N, stresses in Pa, energy in J, and dimensionless quantities as raw numbers.
